notes: Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/CGS-ug.html and cgs.ucsd.edu requirements page. Major requires 14 courses total: 4 core (CGS 2A, 2B, 100A, 100B) plus 10 upper-division courses. Of the 10 upper-division, at least 6 must be CGS courses (at least 3 from the 'intermediate' category and at least 3 from the 'advanced' category) and the remaining 4 are drawn from the published CGS applicable electives taught within the Schools of Social Sciences and Arts & Humanities (departments include Anthropology, Communication, Ethnic Studies, History, Literature, Philosophy, Sociology, Political Science). The four named core courses (CGS 2A, 2B, 100A, 100B) are the only specifically enumerated course codes on the page; intermediate/advanced CGS courses and affiliated-department electives are not individually enumerated (they rotate quarterly per a maintained applicable-courses list), so those three buckets use an upper-division range placeholder rather than confirmed specific codes. Division classification by course number: 2A/2B lower-division, 100A/100B upper-division; note the department itself presents all four together as the introductory core. Counts (2+2+3+3+4) sum to 14, matching the page.

buckets.label: Required core sequence - lower division (Introduction to Critical Gender Studies)
buckets.note: Both required and verified on the page. CGS 2A = Intro to CGS: Key Terms & Concepts; CGS 2B = Intro to CGS: Social Formations. Part of the 4-course required core sequence.

buckets.label: Required core sequence - upper division (Conceptualizing Gender)
buckets.note: Both required and verified on the page. CGS 100A = Conceptualizing Gender: Theoretical Approaches; CGS 100B = Conceptualizing Gender: Methods & Methodologies. Grouped with 2A/2B as the intro core, but upper-division by course number.

buckets.label: Upper-division CGS courses - Intermediate category
buckets.note: At least 3 upper-division CGS courses from the department's 'intermediate' category. Specific codes not enumerated on the page (rotate quarterly); listed as an upper-division CGS range placeholder, not confirmed individual codes.

buckets.label: Upper-division CGS courses - Advanced category
buckets.note: At least 3 upper-division CGS courses from the department's 'advanced' category. Specific codes not enumerated on the page (rotate quarterly); listed as an upper-division CGS range placeholder, not confirmed individual codes.

buckets.label: Upper-division electives from affiliated departments (Social Sciences and Arts & Humanities)
buckets.note: 4 upper-division electives selected from the published 'CGS applicable electives' list in the Schools of Social Sciences and Arts & Humanities (e.g., Anthropology, Communication, Ethnic Studies, History, Literature, Philosophy, Sociology, Political Science). Specific approved course codes vary by quarter and are not enumerated on the requirements page, so no specific codes are asserted here. These are cross-listed CGS-approved courses from non-CGS departments. 4 upper-division electives drawn from the CGS 'applicable courses' list, confirmed against the CGS program applicable-courses page and catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/CGS-ug.html. This is a specific curated cross-listed set (NOT any course in these departments), so explicit codes are listed rather than subject ranges. Social Sciences: Anthropology (ANSC), Communication (COMM), Ethnic Studies (ETHN), Linguistics (LIGN), Political Science (POLI), Psychology (PSYC), Sociology (SOCI). Arts & Humanities: History (HIEA/HILA/HISC/HITO/HIUS), Literature (LTAM/LTCS/LTEA/LTEN/LTEU/LTSP/LTWL), Music (MUSIC 115).
